skill.name: kuaishou-trend-insights
skill.description: Analyze Kuaishou hot searches and keyword video samples through SocialDataX to support content planning, brand research, and creator decisions.
skill.summary: Turn Kuaishou rankings and keyword search samples into traceable trend observations.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts reflect Markdown formatting, service links, and declared API authentication rather than unsafe behavior. One CLI example executes an unpinned npm package with automatic confirmation, creating supply-chain exposure. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or destructive instructions in the reviewed files; external package behavior remains unverified.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples automatically execute socialdatax-skills@latest while the service credential may be available in the environment.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify its provenance and dependency integrity, and obtain user authorization before downloading and executing it.

content.user_title: Analyze Kuaishou Trends with Traceable Evidence
content.value_statement: Content teams need evidence before choosing Kuaishou topics. This skill guides SocialDataX hot-search retrieval and keyword sampling, then separates visible signals from interpretation.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve current Kuaishou hot-search rankings through the documented CLI or an available MCP tool.
Search Kuaishou videos by keyword and collect bounded samples using page or item limits.
Continue keyword searches with complete opaque pagination tokens from the same query chain.
Preserve available video identifiers, share links, author facts, and visible engagement data for traceable observations.
Separate hot-search signals, search samples, and analytical judgments in research summaries.
Retain partial results and resume supported searches within the remaining collection limits.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance.
Direct CLI use requires Node.js and npm; the supplied examples execute an unpinned external package.
Search samples do not represent exhaustive platform coverage or establish historical trend growth.
The documented workflow is read-only and does not support login, posting, likes, comments, or account changes.

use_cases.title: Prioritize content topics
use_cases.description: Compare current hot-search signals with relevant keyword samples before selecting editorial themes.

use_cases.title: Investigate brand conversations
use_cases.description: Collect bounded brand-related video samples and preserve links, author facts, and visible metrics for review.

use_cases.title: Develop creator angles
use_cases.description: Review videos around a focused topic and identify possible content angles without treating sample popularity as guaranteed performance.

prompt_templates.title: Review the current hot-search list
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve the current Kuaishou hot-search list. Summarize rankings and available heat signals, separating observations from interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a keyword sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Kuaishou for [keyword], limited to one page. Retain available titles, authors, video identifiers, links, and engagement data.

prompt_templates.title: Compare content directions
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [topic A] and [topic B] using current hot searches and at most 20 search samples each. Separate sources and qualify coverage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare evidence for content planning.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an incomplete research sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume the partial [keyword] search using its complete continuation token. Preserve earlier results and remaining limits; report missing evidence and potential content angles.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover a bounded research workflow.

output_examples.input: Show the expected format for a Kuaishou hot-search review without inventing live results.
output: Illustrative format only; no live results are shown.
Hot-search evidence: returned rank, topic, and available heat signal.
Interpretation: why the observed topic may warrant further research.
Next step: request a bounded keyword sample before recommending a content direction.

output_examples.input: Show how an incomplete keyword research report should be presented.
output: Illustrative format only; no live results are shown.
Status: incomplete. Preserve collected samples and the returned error.
Evidence: retain available titles, authors, video identifiers, links, and visible metrics.
Recovery: resume with the returned continuation token only after resolving the error and checking remaining limits.
Conclusion: available samples support provisional observations, not a platform-wide trend claim.

best_practices: Start with one page and set explicit collection limits before expanding the research.
Keep visible evidence separate from interpretation, and preserve available links and identifiers.
Use a reviewed, pinned CLI version and keep API keys out of prompts and reports.
anti_patterns: Treating hot-search rankings or small keyword samples as proof of historical growth or complete platform coverage.
Changing continuation tokens, restarting partial searches automatically, or exceeding the original collection limits.
Repeatedly retrying insufficient-balance errors or exposing API keys during troubleshooting.

faq.question: What access does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires a SocialDataX API key and network access. Direct CLI use also requires Node.js and npm.

faq.question: Can it post or modify my Kuaishou account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only. It does not support login, posting, likes, comments, or account changes.

faq.question: Does it retrieve every matching video?
faq.answer: No. Search supports bounded pagination and item limits, but does not provide a stable exhaustive result boundary.

faq.question: Can I use MCP instead of the CLI?
faq.answer: Yes, when the corresponding SocialDataX tools are already available. The skill documents hot-search and keyword-search tool parameters.

faq.question: What happens when service balance is insufficient?
faq.answer: The workflow stops repeated retries and displays the provider billing link. After funding, it resumes under the documented recovery rules.

faq.question: Does the audit verify the downloaded CLI package?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed files reference an unpinned npm package, but do not include its implementation. Review and pin it before execution.
